reused_dos_oracle_evidence.scope: Existing direct DOS comparison for font_MakeImage + f_2650_000F. Diagnostic-only status; reused as prior evidence, not rerun here.

coverage: all 65,536 uint16_t input values for the word byte-swap
boundary and mixed-byte uint32_t byte-swap vectors
descending byte search: first address, later match, miss, and single-byte span
2-bit-byte table expansion: two rows with partial final source-byte groups and destination canaries
byte inversion: count 1..3 and zero count meaning 65,536 byte LOOP iterations
positive byte clear with sentinels before and after the changed range

source_contracts.f_1959_0002: mov ax,[bp+6]; xchg al,ah; return. Maps to simant_dos_swap_word.
source_contracts.f_1959_000C: loads the low argument word into AX and high word into DX, swaps each word's bytes, returning DX:AX. Maps to simant_dos_swap_dword.
source_contracts.f_24FA_0004: STD; REPNE SCASB scans from ES:DI toward lower addresses, CLD restores direction, and the result is the matching address. Portable admitted domain is a valid contiguous native object ending at start and positive count; zero count is excluded because the original leaves ZF dependent on incoming flags.
source_contracts.f_24FA_0029: For admitted positive int16 width/height, DX=ceil(width/2) is the output bytes per row. Four 2-bit groups per source byte are read MSB-first and table-map to FF,F0,0F,00; only ceil(DX/4) source bytes are consumed per row, with unused low groups ignored. This is a byte-transform contract and makes no claim about visual geometry.
source_contracts.f_24FA_00A0: NOT byte [ES:DI]; STOSB; LOOP. For CX=0 LOOP performs 65,536 iterations; the public adapter preserves that behavior and requires a matching writable span.
source_contracts.f_2650_0107: word clear plus odd-byte clear. Positive counts map to simant_dos_clear_bytes. Zero count decrements DI and writes one byte before the supplied pointer; that out-of-object case is explicitly outside the portable API.
source_contracts.f_2650_000F: Not duplicated: existing portable/render/font.c glyph raster is compared against font_MakeImage + original f_2650_000F in portable/tests/render/evidence/dos-render-differential.json, whose pinned status remains diagnostic only.

withheld.f_24FA_00B5: INT 3 breakpoint trap remains unimplemented as a portable utility.

limitations: This probe validates portable controls against the inspected assembly instructions; it does not execute the original DOS functions.

Reverse search assumes the caller supplies a valid native allocation spanning the backward search domain; DOS segment wrap/alias behavior is not modeled. Zero count and null pointer fail explicitly at the original-name adapter boundary.

The packed expansion is byte-for-byte instruction-derived and has native boundary controls, but was not run against an original DOS execution harness in this task. Null pointers and nonpositive dimensions fail explicitly at the original-name adapter boundary.
Positive-count clear is equivalent for its admitted caller domain; the original zero-count write-before-pointer behavior is intentionally not reproduced.
